step1_figure.schematic_figure: Figure 24.29 (approximate, based on Baker's CMOS Circuit Design, Layout, and Simulation, Chapter 24)
step1_figure.circuit_type: Two-Stage Push-Pull (Class AB) Op-Amp with Indirect Miller Compensation
step1_figure.description: This circuit is a two-stage operational amplifier. The first stage is a differential amplifier using split-length NMOS input devices to facilitate indirect (Ahuja-style) Miller compensation. The second stage is a push-pull (Class AB) output stage driven by a differential-to-single-ended level shifting network, providing high output drive capability.

open_loop_gain.description: Low-frequency open-loop voltage gain of the op-amp.

equation.explanation: Product of the intrinsic gains of the first differential stage and the second push-pull stage.
equation.assumptions: Assumes split-length devices act as single transistors with combined length for output resistance.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming Itail = 20uA (Id1 = 10uA) and W/L_1 = 10: gm1 = sqrt(2 * 270u * 10 * 10u) = 232 uA/V. ro = 1/(lambda*Id) = 1/(0.1*10u) = 1 MOhm. Stage 1 gain = 232u * 500k = 116 V/V. Assuming Iout = 50uA and W/L_15 = 40: gm15 = sqrt(2 * 50u * 40 * 50u) = 447 uA/V. ro_out = 1/(0.1*50u) = 200 kOhm. Stage 2 gain = 447u * 100k = 44.7 V/V. Total gain = 116 * 44.7 = 5185 V/V = 74.3 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain depends heavily on the chosen channel lengths and resulting lambda, but typical two-stage topologies in 130nm achieve 60-80 dB.

unity_gain_frequency.description: Frequency at which the open-loop gain drops to 0 dB (or closed-loop -3dB bandwidth in unity gain).

equation.explanation: Bandwidth is determined by the input pair transconductance and the compensation capacitor.
equation.assumptions: Assumes the non-dominant pole is pushed well beyond f_un due to indirect compensation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Using gm1 = 232 uA/V and Cc = 240 fF (from netlist C2/C3): f_un = 232e-6 / (2 * pi * 240e-15) = 153.8 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly tied to the bias current of the input pair and the fixed 240fF compensation capacitors.

slew_rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the output voltage.

equation.explanation: Internal slew rate is limited by the tail current charging the compensation capacitor.
equation.assumptions: Assumes the output stage can source/sink enough current such that the internal node is the bottleneck.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming Itail = 20 uA and Cc = 240 fF: SR = 20e-6 / 240e-15 = 83.3 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the exact bias current set by the Beta-multiplier reference.

power_dissipation.description: Total static power consumed by the op-amp.

equation.explanation: Sum of currents in the bias network, first stage, and output stage multiplied by supply voltage.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming I_bias = 40uA, I_tail = 20uA, I_out = 50uA. Total current = 110uA. P = 1.8V * 110uA = 198 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Class AB output stages have low quiescent current but can drive large dynamic currents.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure closed-loop bandwidth, slew rate, and power dissipation of the unity-gain configured op-amp.
